Interface IF_GameView

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIView, SocketView, VirtualView
public interface IF_GameView extends Remote
Views's Interface for ModelViewController pattern.
Interface for the methods that the Server calls directly on the View in order to notify a request/Error/update.

    • notifyTurn

      void notifyTurn(String nickname, Move move) throws IOException
      Notify the View about the Turn change.
      This method is called in order to notify the View about the turn change, telling who has to move and what he has to do.
      Pre: nickname != null && move != null
      Parameters:
      nickname - Nickname of the Player who has to move.
      move - Next move to perform.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

      Parameters:
      errorType - Error occurred due to a wrong action.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

      Parameters:
      toUpdate - Parameter of the View to update.
      parameters - New updated value for the given parameter.
